facts.fact: ANP reports that on 3 October 2024 the City of Niamey launched the Naney Yarda platform, which is to digitise the census of taxpayers with geolocation, to determine the taxable base across the city.
ANP reports that Naney Yarda was launched for the City of Niamey alone on 3 October 2024; no other commune is mentioned and no count of taxpayers recorded is given.
The Niamey delegated administrator calls Naney Yarda the main pillar of the city's 2025-2027 strategic plan, and the national information society agency ANSI is named as technology partner.

systems.platform: ANSI technology partner; blockchain, AI and big data named
